title: The Concord's courts would sell Lantern's indentures to a new landlord
desc: Varga: under the Tannet Yards ruling the Inspectorate would fine the Company, appoint a receiver and sell the instrument at auction. There is no rescue through that door, only a different landlord.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Varga poured the seal on eleven living miners
desc: At the 300-metre station there were eleven alive on the near side of the ice. The Director ordered the seal poured at the station. Varga gave the order.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Kas sold the root plan to Achterberg for two seats on the Covenant
desc: Eleven days before departure, in the Upper Wards bar: the time, the doors, the bell, the run. One seat for him, one for Pim.

title: Teodor made a third key: the quit-claim
desc: Hidden in the arm of his glasses. Unknown to the Tally's registry. Works alone, once, at the root, and can do one thing: change who is owed.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Every balance on Lantern is owed to the dead of Caul Deep
desc: Set at the root on the forty-ninth day of the Closing with the quit-claim. Creditor: Caul. Holder: none. The Company's claim quit; outside reading keys renewed.
knowers: Ch.19 — The Mouth of the Throat
Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Account is discharged only when the dead's names are spoken at the root
desc: All nine hundred and four, in order, to the Tally. The names exist only on the Mercy Bell.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Kas carried the bell through the Throat as it closed
desc: He took the Magpie off the Covenant's collar and ran the Throat behind the shear, to get the names out. The tug came out wrecked on the Concord side; the bell turned up at Tannet thirty years later.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Hulk is the carrier Covenant, come home
desc: She came back from the Throat with her hold torn open and was run nose-first into the old cargo dock under the Counting House. The Count told its children she was the Ardent Mercy.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Count descends from the Company's four hundred and six
desc: The essential staff who came home on the Covenant kept the books. By year 61 the Count had turned the debt to the dead into the doctrine of the dark and hidden the reserve.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Haste can revive Fen's family debt
desc: The painting her great-grandmother sold to clear the family bond may not have been hers to sell. Haste uses it to make Corvin sign.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Tally is quit
desc: With the last name spoken the Account of Caul is discharged; no balance, no creditor, no debtor. The valves are released to open.
